name: BCD to 7-Segment Display Driver
objectives: Decode 4-bit Binary Coded Decimal (A, B, C, D) to drive 7 LED segments (a, b, c, d, e, f, g).
Construct segment driver sub-networks using basic gate ICs (7404, 7408, 7411, 7432).
Understand segment decoding equations derived from K-maps.
theory: A BCD to 7-Segment Decoder translates 4-bit binary inputs (0000 to 1001) into signals that illuminate specific LED segments (a-g) to display numbers 0-9.

foundation.title: Foundation (Basic Gates)
foundation.description: Construct segment driver networks using 2-input AND (7408), 3-input AND (7411), NOT (7404), and OR (7432) gates.

optimization.title: Universal NAND Gate Synthesis
optimization.description: Rebuild segment drivers using ONLY Universal NAND gates (IC 7400).

industrial.title: Universal NOR Gate Synthesis
industrial.description: Rebuild segment drivers using ONLY Universal NOR gates (IC 7402).
